issues.summary_zh: 这是 Tavotto 0.21.3 及更早版本在 Windows 上已知的问题：环境自检时，写入保护把自检自己的输出拦下了，并不是你的环境或脚本有错。
issues.summary_en: Known issue in Tavotto 0.21.3 and earlier on Windows: during the environment self-check the write guard blocks the check's own output. Neither your environment nor your script is at fault.

workaround.user_steps_zh: 换用你自己已装好所需包的 Python：在环境设置里点「换用我的 Python」，选好后重新运行。
workaround.user_steps_en: Use a Python of your own that already has the packages you need: choose "Use my own Python" in the environment settings, pick it, then run again.
